convert_model_to_MOLE_model: convert a PyTorch model to use MOLE mixed expert linear layers for molecular machine learning
replace_linear_with_MOLE: replace an existing linear layer with a MOLE mixed expert layer using global tensors
recursive_replace_so2_linear: recursively replace all linear layers in SO2 convolution modules with a replacement factory
recursive_replace_all_linear: recursively replace all torch.nn.Linear layers in a model with a replacement factory
model_search_and_replace: search model blocks by index and apply a module replacement function to each layer
